svg.aria-label: How the citation walk decides where to go and when to stop. The next hop is led by the works that most of the seeds you chose agree on, tie-broken by nearness to the seeds era, not by citation count: a work reached by one seed with forty-one thousand citations from 1962 is an ancestor of everything rather than this field's shared reference. The walk stops when sixty per cent of a hop was already reached, when four hundred works are reached at the cap, which is a budget and not convergence, or when nothing new is left to walk from. A hop whose calls the index refused reports itself incomplete, which is a fourth outcome and not one of the three.
